clauses.title: Revocation checking PAdES signatures at the current time
clauses.requirement: For the current-time check, the current UTC instant must fall within the CRL thisUpdate/nextUpdate interval for the CRL to establish current status.

clauses.title: Revocation checking PAdES signatures at a time in the past
clauses.requirement: Historical signer-path validation uses the past validation instant and permits later-collected CRL evidence subject to its separate capture-before-certificate-expiry and nextUpdate-after-past-time conditions. This does not make the .4.7 current-time interval rule mode-less.

clauses.title: Document Security Store (DSS)
clauses.requirement: The DSS dictionary is used to collect validation certificates, CRLs and OCSP responses relevant to the signature; this fixture places its CRL in the Catalog DSS.

source.errata: No EC3 annotation modifies the current-versus-past CRL applicability condition in §§12.8.3.4.7–.8. The nearby change in this area is #448's version note under §12.8.4.1, not a change to the CRL window.

rows.claim: Good status requires the asked instant between thisUpdate and nextUpdate.
A timestamp-established historical instant is used for certificate validity and revocation status.

implementation_trace: With no trusted signature or document timestamp, the fixed instant supplied in TrustPolicy remains the best signature time; `about_one` passes it to Signature::trust, then trust::Search::walk calls revocation::status_within.

revocation::from_list checks issuer/signature and listed revocations, then accepts an unlisted certificate when asked_at <= nextUpdate. The no-policy path does not require asked_at >= thisUpdate; comments explicitly say a later-issued list answers an earlier instant.
A public report uses Verdict::of with the host's Acceptance. With RevocationMustBeGood, Unknown revocation withholds 'locally valid'; Good permits it if the other checks pass.

controls: A genuine signed CAdES PDF with an exact xref and embedded root/leaf chain, DSS CRL, no-recovery parse, and OpenSSL detached verification.
In-window CRL positive control at one minute before the host instant.
Same certificate, anchor, host instant, signature shape, and nextUpdate, with thisUpdate one minute after host time as the discriminating fixture.
No mode-less duplicated status call or false claim that historical later-issued evidence must be rejected.
